summary: A fresh authenticated cursor-agent 2026.08.11-e8db854 probe confirmed newline-delimited system, user, thinking, assistant, and result records, including partial timestamps and a terminal assistant record without timestamp_ms. The empirically grounded decoder from fc30ab0 was cherry-picked onto the actual current HEAD, verified with focused, race, and full tests, committed, and installed as lucind-ai 01e11c1.

files_changed.why: Select stream-json only when progress is requested, normalize observed records, ignore unknown valid records, and fall back to blocking JSON for absent or malformed streams.
Cover observed known records, unknown valid records, and empty or unparseable stream fallback.
Record schema-validated packet evidence after the implementation commit existed.

external_changes.why: The packet explicitly required make install after changing binary code; lucind-ai -v now reports commit 01e11c1.
external_changes.revert: Reinstall lucind-ai from the prior worktree commit b4fb53205a710cb25f1b559563d618d5caff6eef using make install.

done_criteria.criterion: Empirical output capture is attached to result evidence and decoder tests cover known and unknown records.
Only the three allowed paths change and the commit is recorded.
done_criteria.evidence: Commit 01e11c1571dbf90e50ea244949a4eba7e48aad1a. git diff HEAD^ HEAD --name-only listed exactly internal/executor/cursor_agent.go and internal/executor/cursor_agent_test.go; numstat was 119/3 and 120/0 (239 tracked changed lines). .lucind/result.json is the only ignored packet artifact and is intentionally not committed. make install succeeded, and lucind-ai -v reported 'lucind-ai 01e11c1 (go1.25.0, linux/amd64)'.

findings.finding: The supplied fc30ab0 commit was not directly based on the current HEAD, so a fast-forward was impossible; its parent was 64b6b2c while current HEAD was b4fb532.
findings.evidence: git rev-parse fc30ab0^ => 64b6b2cc7539d4432457cc082bb6a82c8b599ae5; git rev-parse HEAD before apply => b4fb53205a710cb25f1b559563d618d5caff6eef. The exact patch cherry-picked cleanly as 01e11c1.
findings.affects: Branch-topology assumptions for packet reuse; implementation behavior and allowed-path scope were unchanged.

findings.finding: The first full-suite run, launched concurrently with the race suite and installation, hit transient unrelated SQLITE_BUSY and per-lane deadline failures; both failed tests passed individually and the complete suite passed on a clean rerun.
findings.evidence: Initial failures: internal/ledger TestConcurrentProgressAndSetStatus and internal/run TestExecuteBatchAppliesPerLaneDeadlineIndependently. Individual reruns passed in 0.143s and 0.274s; subsequent go test ./... -count=1 passed all 19 packages.
findings.affects: Test execution should avoid unnecessary concurrent heavyweight suites when collecting deterministic full-suite evidence.
